answer: A concrete sybil-defense mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The beacon words fit the design: copper embodies the flow of attestations that gives each answer finality, wharf maps onto the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, and summit tracks the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
